source.title: Optimality and stability - some unsolved problems

trace.notes: Normalized the single input URL as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver record. The zbMATH API record identified document id 3890240 as Y. V. Venkatesh, "Optimality and stability - some unsolved problems," Wiss. Z., Tech. Hochsch. Leipz. 8, 97-106 (1984), Zbl 0558.49020.

Failure mode: metadata_only. The zbMATH record exposed bibliographic and review metadata but no PDF, DOI, arXiv, EuDML, Geodesic, publisher, repository, or other full-text link. Metadata and review text were not used as the technical extraction source.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched for the exact title, title plus author, title plus journal, and journal/pages/year/author. Candidate results were rejected because they were unrelated works, broad search pages, or snippets rather than readable full text for the same 1984 article.
No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source was recovered, so source adequacy failed and no questions were extracted.
Saved the final JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/3890240.json and outputs/latest.json.
